explanation: King Suryavarman II had Angkor Wat built as a Hindu temple to Vishnu, and it became a Buddhist site later. Notre-Dame's first stone was laid in 1163.

claims.text: Building work on Angkor Wat began in the early 12th century, under King Suryavarman II.
Building work on Notre-Dame de Paris began in 1163.
Angkor Wat was built as a Hindu temple dedicated to Vishnu and later became a Buddhist site.
